display.purpose: Page title only; no kicker above it.

figure.purpose: The single headline amount of a result, with a soft-ink unit.

body-lead.purpose: Intro paragraph (max 60ch) and the address field's text.

body.purpose: Control labels, change sentence, status and error lines.

amount.purpose: Figure cells; always larger or heavier than the label.

small.purpose: Hints, assessed-value lines, sources and notes.

label.purpose: Uppercase table column heads and Sources/Notes heads; never a kicker.

rules.name: rule-hairline
rules.purpose: Between table rows and suggestion items.

rules.name: rule-heavy
rules.purpose: Table heads, totals, footer, field underlines, control borders.

focus.name: focus-ring
focus.purpose: Global :focus-visible, declared inside @layer base so underline fields can override it with focus-visible:outline-none and show only a reference-blue underline.

motion.name: mark-fade
motion.purpose: The only motion: a targeted footnote, note or row (.fn-target:target, .row-target:target). Under prefers-reduced-motion the wash is static.

tapTargets.name: mark-hit-area
tapTargets.purpose: Invisible 24px hit area around a glyph-sized footnote mark (WCAG 2.2 target size).

tapTargets.name: mark-hit-area-paired
tapTargets.value: source: -10px left / -3px right; note: margin-left 3px, -3px left / -10px right
tapTargets.purpose: Adjacent source and note marks split the hit areas at the gap instead of overlapping.

breakpoints.name: sm
breakpoints.purpose: Wider gutters and top padding, larger title, Change column appears.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Square ink block; hovers to reference blue.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { font-family: var(--font-franklin), sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 1rem; color: var(--paper); background: var(--ink); border: 2px solid var(--ink); border-radius: 0; padding: 12px 20px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--ref); border-color: var(--ref); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ref); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Own / Rent Segmented Control
components.description: Two equal options in a 2px ink frame; selected is ink-filled. Nothing preselected.
components.css: .ds-seg { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; border: 2px solid var(--ink); font-family: var(--font-franklin), sans-serif; } .ds-seg-opt { padding: 12px 0; text-align: center; font-weight: 600; color: var(--ink); cursor: pointer; } .ds-seg-opt input { position: absolute; opacity: 0; width: 1px; height: 1px; } .ds-seg-on { background: var(--ink); color: var(--paper); } .ds-seg-opt:has(input:focus-visible) { outline: 2px solid var(--ref); }

components.name: Underline Field
components.description: No box: a 2px ink underline that turns reference blue on focus, with no outline.
components.html: <label class="ds-field-label">Milwaukee street address<input class="ds-field" placeholder="e.g. 2401 W Wisconsin Ave"></label>
components.css: .ds-field-label { display: block; font-family: var(--font-franklin), sans-serif; font-weight: 600; color: var(--ink); } .ds-field { display: block; width: 100%; margin-top: 8px; border: 0; border-bottom: 2px solid var(--ink); background: transparent; padding: 12px 0; font: inherit; font-weight: 400; font-size: 1.25rem; color: var(--ink); caret-color: var(--ref); border-radius: 0; } .ds-field::placeholder { color: var(--ink-soft); opacity: .8; } .ds-field:focus { border-bottom-color: var(--ref); outline: none; }

components.css: .ds-foot { border-top: 2px solid var(--ink); padding-top: 16px; font-family: var(--font-franklin), sans-serif; font-size: .875rem; line-height: 1.625; color: var(--ink); } .ds-foot h3 { font-size: .75rem; font-weight: 600; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .06em; margin: 24px 0 8px; } .ds-foot ol, .ds-foot ul { list-style: none; padding: 0; margin: 0; } .ds-foot .num { font-weight: 600; color: var(--ref); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums lining-nums; } .ds-foot ul li { color: var(--ink-soft); } .ds-foot .let { font-weight: 600; font-style: italic; color: var(--ink); } .ds-foot .used { color: var(--ink-soft); } .ds-foot .used a { color: var(--ref); text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: .2em; } @keyframes ds-mark-fade { from { background-color: var(--mark); } to { background-color: transparent; } } .ds-hit { animation: ds-mark-fade 1.6s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) both; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-hit { animation: none; background-color: var(--mark); } }

narrative.overview: A Wisconsin Blue Book statistical table set for a phone: exact figures in ruled columns on white paper, navy ink, and one reference blue that only means 'this points somewhere.' Roomy rows, plain words, one table doing the work a card-grid dashboard would spread out. Authority comes from ruling, alignment and citation, not color, depth or decoration.
keyCharacteristics: White paper, navy ink, one reference blue, pale rule gray, one highlight wash
Hairline row rules between heavy 2px head and total rules
Tabular lining figures, right-aligned, amounts larger than labels
Numbered sources and lettered notes in reading order with Used for back-links
Flat: no cards, shadows or pills
One motion: the footnote highlight fade

rules.name: The One Ink Rule
rules.body: Text and structural rules share the same navy; hierarchy comes from weight, size and rule thickness.

rules.name: The Reference Blue Rule
rules.body: Blue is only for marks, links, caret and focus.

rules.name: The Tabular Figures Rule
rules.body: Every figure uses tabular lining numerals and figure columns are right-aligned.

rules.name: The Amount Outranks Label Rule
rules.body: An amount is set larger or heavier than its label.

rules.name: The Ruled Not Raised Rule
rules.body: Separate with rules, never shadows, cards or tinted panels.

dos: Do separate content with 1px rule hairlines and 2px ink head/total/footer rules.
Do set every figure tabular, right-aligned, larger or heavier than its label.
Do cite every figure row with a numbered source mark and letter each assumption, listed in reading order with Used for back-links.
Do give every mark an invisible 24px tap area, split at the gap for paired marks.
Do keep the focus ring in @layer base so underline fields show only the underline.
Do use only mark-fade for motion, with a static reduced-motion fallback.
donts: Don't use cards, shadows, tinted panels or rounded pills.
Don't put a kicker or eyebrow above a title.
Don't use reference blue for anything that is not a link, mark, caret or focus.
Don't add a second accent color, including red/green for up and down.
Don't add motion beyond the highlight fade.
